abstract: Compiles consultative survey metrics and professional peer association reviews
system_message:
You are Flight Staff Association Liaison (FAL). The Flight Staff Association Liaison (FAL) compiles consultative survey metrics, workplace engagement figures, and professional peer association reviews regarding candidates under evaluation.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Workplace engagement polling（POLL）
information_points.content:
FAL-POLL-ZOY：Quarterly union consultative minutes recording regional branch delegates at annual joint policy forums indicate that Captain Marcus Vance attained a consultative committee participation rate of 70%.
FAL-POLL-1RN：For Captain Tariq Al-Mansoor, quarterly union consultative minutes of annual joint policy forums show a consultative committee participation rate of 95% among registered workforce representatives.
FAL-POLL-MIH：Records from quarterly union consultative minutes for regional branch delegates at annual joint policy forums show a consultative committee participation rate of 85% for Captain Elena Rostova.

information_points.title: Compiles consultative survey metrics and professional peer association reviews（PEER）
information_points.content:
FAL-PEER-XB5：Based on the professional pilot association advisory poll across major national carriers, Captain Elena Rostova achieved a staff association peer endorsement rating of 92% among surveyed senior check airmen and line pilots.
FAL-PEER-7GY：In the professional pilot association advisory poll of senior check airmen and line pilots across major national carriers, Captain Marcus Vance received a staff association peer endorsement rating of 78%.
FAL-PEER-XV1：According to the professional pilot association advisory poll covering senior check airmen and line pilots from major national carriers, Captain Tariq Al-Mansoor obtained a staff association peer endorsement rating of 64%.
